errors.rule: Never treat a local append as certified before an authenticated external high-water commit; reconcile after interruption.
Abort only an exact matching reservation when the local registry still equals the old checkpoint.
Fail closed; do not silently rewrite either checkpoint.
Block new appends until an interrupted transaction has been explicitly reconciled under exclusive coordinator lock.
A local SQLite lock is not a distributed lock; require independent conditional writes and a distributed lock or single writer.
A synthetic in-memory pin-store PASS is not deployment or genuine provenance evidence.
